assets.name: city_wall_citadel_v1
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Square 1024x1024 opaque texture, orthographic straight-on, fills the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge. Seamlessly repeatable in X and Y. NO border, objects, writing, perspective, vignette, focal light spot or ground shadow. Keep total contrast gentle and wall medium dark so characters and golden windows stand out. No giant boulders, no moss clumps.

assets.name: city_arcade_spandrels_v1
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original RGBA sprite atlas for dark fantasy side-view 2D game. Landscape1536x1024, TRUE transparent background including arch holes. EXACTLY THREE separate long horizontal architectural spandrel modules, stacked in three equal-height rows, each centered with large transparent gutters. Every module 1400px wide and about240px deep. Each has straight flat upper edge, vertical left/right ends, and a SINGLE shallow broad smooth arch opening cut into its underside: bottom edge curves upward at center, leaving a thinner stone band at middle and thicker triangular haunches on the sides. NO long legs or piers, no columns or ground. They will hang directly beneath elevated stone walkways. Strict front orthographic view, same width and height in all three rows. Row1 muted bluegrey observatory limestone, finely jointed arch voussoirs. Row2 slightly green weathered garden stone with a few small trailing ivy leaves attached near the edges. Row3 darker old violetgrey civic limestone with chipped thin moulding and restrained brass keystone. Detailed painterly believable masonry, soft neutral lighting, dark seams and aged bevels, NOT schematic outlines. Transparent arch voids show nothing. No background wall, fake sky, text, labels, checkerboard, drop shadow, glowing rim, scenery, perspective or additional objects.
